name: Ghost OS
description: Lets any MCP-capable agent see and operate every macOS app through the accessibility tree, with vision fallback and replayable JSON recipes, for users automating Mac workflows.

skills.name: Native App Control
skills.description: Reads the macOS accessibility tree to click, type, and navigate in any app, falling back to a local vision model when needed.

skills.name: Workflow Recipes
skills.description: Saves workflows as transparent JSON recipes with parameters and wait conditions and replays them on demand.

skills.name: Learn by Demonstration
skills.description: Watches the user perform a task once and turns the recorded actions into a parameterized recipe.
